source.coverage: Global, 90N-90S, 0-360E; simple cylindrical; IAU2000; areoid GMM3 (mgm1025) to degree and order 50
source.spatial_resolution: 0.0625 deg (16 ppd) = ~3.7 km per cell at the equator
source.observation_period: 1997-09-15 to 2001-06-30 (MGS mapping, primary and extended missions)
source.uncertainty_notes: Each cell is the MEDIAN of MOLA shots inside it; near the equator only ~55% of cells contain a shot and the rest are interpolated, with gaps of up to 12 km between profiles. The MOLA team reports radial (vertical) shot accuracy of order 1 m after crossover adjustment (Smith et al., 2001, J. Geophys. Res. 106(E10), doi:10.1029/2000JE001364; not stated in this product label); interpolated cells inherit the local relief uncertainty. Slopes and roughness are REGIONAL (~3.7 km baseline) and say nothing about metre-scale hazards.

source.license: NASA PDS data are public domain; cite the MOLA Science Team
